_meta.purpose: Persistent topical-coverage map for the McBride PM daily blog. The routine reads this every run to publish into the weakest cluster, and updates it after every publish. Never delete history; only refine. coverage is 0-1 (share of the cluster's important subtopics covered well). authority is low|medium|high. Built 2026-06-25 from the live 55-post archive; the routine recalculates coverage after each post.
_meta.builtFrom: 92 live posts in src/blog/ as of 2026-10-04
_meta.updateRule: After publishing, recompute the affected cluster's coverage, add the slug to posts[], remove the answered item from gaps[]. Always publish into the lowest (coverage x authorityWeight) cluster unless a refresh (see published-log) scores higher.
